title: How to Get a PRC ID (Initial Registration)
description: Register your professional license and obtain your PRC ID through the LERIS online portal after passing the board exam.

blocks.content: The **PRC ID** (Professional Identification Card) is the official license issued by the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) to Filipinos who have passed their respective Licensure Examinations (Board Exams). It is recognized as a top-tier **Primary ID** for all legal and financial transactions.

The PRC ID is commonly used for:
*   Legally practicing your profession (Nurse, Teacher, Engineer, etc.)
*   Primary identification for banking and passports
*   Proof of professional standing and ethics

You may need a PRC ID if you are:
- A new board exam passer (Initial Registration)
- An existing professional whose license has expired (Renewal)
- A professional needing to update their status or record

content.title: Benefits of Having a PRC ID

blocks.content: Beyond being a legal requirement to work, the PRC ID carries significant prestige and utility.

blocks.title: Professional Authority
blocks.content: It serves as your "license to practice," allowing you to sign official documents and certifications in your field.

blocks.title: High-Level Identification
blocks.content: It is universally accepted as a Primary ID, often carrying more weight than a basic government ID in high-security transactions.

blocks.title: Online (LERIS Portal)
blocks.content: The application, scheduling, and payment are all done via the [PRC LERIS Portal](https://online.prc.gov.ph/).

blocks.title: Personal Appearance
blocks.content: After the online steps, you **must** personally appear at your chosen PRC office to sign the professional roster and submit documents.
**Pro Tip:** Most ID applications now require **Online Pre-registration**. Always take a screenshot of your QR code or transaction slip before heading to the office.

blocks.title: LERIS Online Registration
blocks.content: Log in to [online.prc.gov.ph](https://online.prc.gov.ph/). Click on **"Initial Registration"** and enter your profession and application number.

blocks.title: Book Appointment and Pay
blocks.content: Select your preferred PRC branch and appointment date. Pay the fees (usually ₱800–₱1,050) via GCash, Maya, or Credit Card.

blocks.title: Print Forms
blocks.content: Download and print your **Oath Form** and **Appointment Slip** from the "Existing Transactions" tab.

blocks.title: Attend Oath-Taking
blocks.content: You must participate in the mass or special oath-taking ceremony (face-to-face or virtual as scheduled).

blocks.title: Visit PRC for ID Issuance
blocks.content: On your appointment date, go to the PRC office. Submit your documents and sign the Professional Registry. You will typically receive your PRC ID on the same day or be given a claiming schedule.

Applicants may process their PRC ID at:
- [PRC LERIS Online Portal](https://online.prc.gov.ph/)
- **PRC Regional Offices:** (Manila, Cebu, Davao, Baguio, etc.)
- **PRC Service Centers:** (Robinsons Malls and SM Malls)

Typical processing timelines include:
*   Online Step: 15 Minutes
*   Personal Appearance: 1–4 Hours (Same Day)
You can track your application status in the **"Existing Transactions"** section of your LERIS account.

Applicants may experience:
- **No Record Found:** Ensure you entered the correct application number from your NOA.
- **Payment Not Reflecting:** If the system doesn't update, wait 24 hours before trying again to avoid double payment.

items: **Incomplete Requirements:** Forgetting documentary stamps or brown envelopes can cause delays.
**Wrong Branch:** Going to a different PRC branch than the one you selected in LERIS.

blocks.content: Always check the "Mandatory Requirements" for your specific profession, as some (like Medicine or Law) have additional steps.

items: Book appointments at PRC Service Centers in malls; they are often faster and less crowded than regional offices.
Keep a digital copy of your NOA and Oath Form on your phone.
Buy your documentary stamps in advance if you want to skip the line inside the PRC.

blocks.title: How long is the PRC ID valid?
blocks.content: It is valid for **three (3) years** and is renewable on your birth month.

blocks.title: Can I send a representative for initial registration?
blocks.content: Generally, no. Initial registration requires a personal signature in the professional roster (signing the book). Renewals, however, can be done by a representative with an SPA.
